positiveDuration.description: A Go duration above zero, e.g. 500ms, 30s or 1m30s. The agent, the controller and the console refuse zero, negative and unit-less durations at startup.

checkerInterval.description: A checker interval: a Go duration of at least 100ms, or the agent refuses to start with the checker enabled. The schema refuses a single value below that, such as a 5ns typo for 5s, 50ms or 0.05s; a spelling in several parts, such as 50ms40ms, is left to the agent.

checkerTimeout.description: A checker timeout: a Go duration of at least 1ms, or the agent refuses to start with the checker enabled. The schema refuses a single value below that, such as a 5ns typo for 5s; a spelling in several parts is left to the agent.

zeroDuration.description: A Go duration of zero: 0, 0s, 0m0s and the like.

objectName.description: A Kubernetes object name (DNS-1123 subdomain): lowercase alphanumerics, '-' or '.', starting and ending alphanumeric, at most 253 characters. The console refuses anything else at startup.

baseURL.description: Empty, or an absolute http(s) URL without a trailing slash; the console refuses anything else at startup.

cidr.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 prefix with its length, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8 or fd00::/8. A bare address has no prefix length, and the agent, the console and the apiserver refuse it.

ipv4Cidr.description: An IPv4 prefix with its length, e.g. 10.244.0.0/16: an except entry of 0.0.0.0/0 can only be IPv4 and must be a strict subset of it, so /0 is refused. Host bits are checked at render time.

threshold.description: A RATIO in 0.0-1.0, never a percent. Every rule using this shape compares a rate ratio directly, so a percent-shaped 5 renders `> 5` and can never fire — silently, because the render succeeds and the alert simply never triggers. The bound is what turns that into a refusal at install time.

type.description: No ClusterIP: an external agent cannot reach one.

nodePort.description: 0 lets the apiserver pick; the valid range is the apiserver's --service-node-port-range, which the chart cannot know.

detail.description: Scrape-time cardinality valve on the agent ServiceMonitor. full keeps everything (~70 series per directed pair); counters-only drops the four per-pair histograms (~10/pair left); zone-only drops every per-pair series (~0/pair, zone family plus the linear DNS/HTTP/external families remain). Anything but full requires serviceMonitor.enabled.

role.description: Fixed role for every anonymous request; one of the four built-ins.

defaultRole.description: Role for an authenticated subject no binding matches; empty means none. A custom role name is not resolved here — the console refuses it at startup.

ttl.description: Absolute session lifetime as a duration string. It has NO zero form: the console refuses to start on auth.session.ttl <= 0 (config.go), because a session with no lifetime is a session that never expires. Only idleTimeout below takes 0.

idleTimeout.description: Duration string, or the integer 0 which disables the idle bound (documented in values.yaml and the READMEs).

secure.description: A __Host- cookie needs Secure: browsers drop it otherwise, and the console refuses the pair at startup.

groupRoles.description: Group asserted by the identity provider -> role this console grants. Union with API-made bindings; a group absent from the map grants nothing.

issuer.description: An absolute https URL without a trailing slash: discovery appends /.well-known/openid-configuration.

grpcAddr.description: REMOVED: renamed to grpcAddress. Permissive here so the template's own fail message, which says what to do, wins over a bare schema rejection.

trustedProxyCIDRs.description: Proxies whose X-Forwarded-For gives the client address; never used for identity.

promqlPerMinute.description: PromQL proxy requests per subject per minute; 0 disables the limit.

maxConnections.description: Open /ws sockets per console replica; 0 disables the cap.

maxConnectionsPerAddress.description: Open /ws sockets per client address; 0 disables the cap.

maxConnectionsPerSubject.description: Open /ws sockets per user or API token; 0 disables the cap.

reloadInterval.description: Duration string, or the integer 0 which never reloads (documented in values.yaml).

encryptionKeySecret.description: REMOVED: renamed to existingSecret / existingSecretKey. Permissive here so the template's own fail message wins over a bare schema rejection.

redisEgress.description: Egress rules to the Redis-compatible bus. Empty renders TCP 6379 to any pod or address.

valkeyEgress.description: REMOVED: renamed to redisEgress. Permissive here so the template's own fail message, which says what to do, wins over a bare schema rejection.

valkeyIngressFrom.description: REMOVED: the chart installs no bus. Permissive here so the template's own fail message wins over a bare schema rejection.

database.description: REMOVED: moved to the top-level database.*. The chart fails with migration instructions.

valkey.description: REMOVED: moved to the top-level redis.*. The chart fails with migration instructions.

if.description: The console polls alert transitions for webhooks only with alerting on and a webhook key named.

controllerAgentTtl.description: Grace period before an agent without a heartbeat leaves the peer list. A Go duration of at least 10s (two agent heartbeats); the controller refuses anything shorter, and 0 is not how eviction is disabled.

size.description: IP-level bytes; 0 means the MTU of the route to the peer. Anything else must be a valid IPv4 datagram size an MTU can have.

items.description: host, IP, host:port or [IPv6]:port with a port of 1-65535; the agent refuses any other port at startup.

url.description: An http or https URL with a host; the agent refuses any other scheme at startup.

expectStatus.description: 0 (unset) accepts any status below 400; anything else must be an HTTP status code between 100 and 599, which the agent checks at startup.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Per-target opt-out from certificate verification for the node-local HTTP checker. Off by default -- certificates ARE verified; documented in docs/configuration.md.

timeout.description: 0 is the agent default (10s); anything else must be at least 1ms.

metricsPort.description: Port serving /metrics and the health endpoints, separate from the API port.

mode.description: full probes every peer from every agent (today's behaviour); sparse trims the plan to a ring over sorted node names plus cross-zone chords. Emitted into the shared config only when sparse, because a pre-2.3.0 controller image rejects the key.

ringDegree.description: Ring successors per node; at least 1, or the plan loses the connectivity guarantee.

zoneChords.description: Cross-zone chords per agent, 0-64; 0 leaves zone coverage to whatever the ring happens to cross, and a fleet that wants more wants the full mesh.

autoThreshold.description: Fleets smaller than this many nodes get the full mesh regardless of mode; 0 disables the floor.

rules.description: REMOVED: the pre-1.12 full-override list. Permissive here so the template's own fail message wins over a bare schema rejection.

ciliumKubeAPIEgress.description: auto renders a CiliumNetworkPolicy allowing the controller (and the console, when it calls the apiserver) egress to the kube-apiserver entity when the cilium.io/v2 CiliumNetworkPolicy API exists; true or false forces it. Rendered only with networkPolicy.enabled.

externalAgentCidrs.description: Plain CIDR strings, not rule objects; each becomes one ipBlock on the gateway port.

nodeCidrs.description: Plain CIDR strings; each becomes one ipBlock on the controller gRPC ingress rule. Required together with agent.hostNetwork.

clusterCIDRs.description: IPv4 pod and Service CIDRs, each an except entry of the default 0.0.0.0/0 ipBlock in httpEgress, webhookEgress, oidcEgress and geoipEgress.

externalPeerCidrs.description: Plain CIDR strings; each becomes one ipBlock on the agent-to-agent probe rules, ingress and egress, never on the gateway rule.

dnsEgress.description: Egress rules that replace the default cluster DNS rule (UDP/TCP 53 to any pod) in the agent, controller and console policies. Needed for NodeLocal DNSCache or any host-network resolver, which no namespaceSelector matches.

prometheusPodLabels.description: Pod labels of the scraper; empty admits the whole prometheusNamespace on the metrics port.

cnpgOperatorNamespace.description: REMOVED. Permissive here so the template's own fail message, which says what to do, wins over a bare schema rejection.

cnpgOperatorPodLabels.description: REMOVED. Permissive here so the template's own fail message, which says what to do, wins over a bare schema rejection.

existingSecret.description: Secret holding a full postgres:// DSN; setting it enables the database.

mode.description: REMOVED — a DSN is the whole configuration. The chart fails with instructions.

cnpg.description: REMOVED — the chart does not install PostgreSQL. The chart fails with instructions.

existingSecret.description: Secret holding a full redis:// DSN; setting it enables the shared bus.

mode.description: REMOVED — a DSN is the whole configuration. The chart fails with instructions.

address.description: REMOVED — the DSN carries the host. The chart fails with instructions.

pdb.description: MOVED to controller.pdb. The chart fails with instructions.

valkey.description: REMOVED — no subcharts. The chart fails with instructions.

cnpg-operator.description: REMOVED — no subcharts. The chart fails with instructions.
